title: He hopped down from his perch
html_source: Mulligan momentarily takes on the characteristics of a bird. This image isn’t extended, but it communicates the qualities of Mulligan’s behaviour on the walls of the tower: he is an entertaining performer for anyone who will listen, but it’s a mindless sort of song.
